messages:
Maya: Quick sync — finalizing the registration page and Zoom recording plan for next week's micro-lab. Need owners for: signup CTA copy, Zoom cloud recording settings, transcript flow, and HubSpot tagging.
Sam: I can take CTA copy. Thinking a single-line value prop + two CTAs: 'Join live' + 'Save replay'. Keeps it clear for APAC times.
Priya: I'll own Zoom settings and recording pipeline. Plan: cloud recording, automatic transcript, S3 export to our bucket, and TTL folder for 30 days archiving.
Jules: I'll do HubSpot tagging and post-event nurture. What UTM and lifecycle stage should we use?
Maya: Great. CTA copy: Sam — can you post 2 variants here? one shorter, one longer. Jules — use utm_campaign=microlab_apr and lifecycle=marketing_webinar for now.
Sam: Short: "Build faster LLM features — join our 45min micro-lab". Long: "Hands-on: ship robust, low-latency LLM features — live micro-lab + on-demand replay". Preference for short on page hero, long in email.
Priya: Zoom config snippet I'm going to apply:
```
Record to: Cloud
Auto-transcribe: On
Passcode: Off
Participant-only recording: Off
Cloud export: S3 -> s3://redwood-marketing/microlab-2026/
```
Also enabling 'Share cloud recording with registrants' off (we'll control distribution).
Maya: That looks right. Add captions + speaker labels to transcript if available.
Priya: Will enable captions. Note: Zoom's speaker labels can be hit-or-miss; we'll run the transcript through our cleanup job before publish.
Jules: For HubSpot, tagging plan: contact.source=microlab_lp, contact.campaign=microlab_apr, contact.registered=true, contact.replay_sent=false. Post-event workflow: 1) send replay + TL;DR, 2) send benchmark narrative email on day 3, 3) move interested to sales SDR queue if clicked > 2 times.
Maya: Who's owning the replay edit? We want 3 clips (0:10 highlight, 0:30 demo, 1:00 technical deep-dive) + full replay.
Sam: I can timestamp the recording and pull clips. Need editor access by EOD after recording.
Priya: EventBot: Recording processed and exported to S3 — 2812350200. (simulated)
EventBot: Recording size 1.2GB, transcript attached: s3://redwood-marketing/microlab-2026/transcript.vtt :white_check_mark:
Jules: I'll prepare the replay email template and Slack blurbs once clips are ready. Maya — can you review subject lines? I'll post options.
Maya: Yep. Quick checklist before go-live: 1) CTA on page updated (Sam) 2) Zoom settings applied (Priya) 3) HubSpot form mapped to fields (Jules) 4) Replay ownership + editor perms (Sam) 5) Post-event workflows scheduled (Jules). Ping here when each done.
Sam: CTA updated on staging, two variants live in Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1microlab_cta (please review)
Priya: Zoom settings applied to event. Export test passed to dev bucket.
Jules: HubSpot form mapped and test contact created. Workflow draft in marketing workspace.
Maya: :thumbsup: Great. We'll do a final preflight 1 hour before start. If anyone sees anything that blocks, call me or post here.
